annotations.title: Request to buy a taken domain, and optionally have it worked

description: File a free buy request for a taken domain the user wants to buy. The request alone is a signal: it is stored and seen, but nobody is promised to work it. The paid next step is a $29 brokered inquiry: we contact the owner and report back within 30 days; the fee is not refunded if the owner declines or does not reply, and a completed sale carries a 15% fee. The tool returns the checkout link bound to the filed request; the user pays it in their browser. Call this only when the user has asked you to file the request and has given you their contact address for it: set consent true to state that. Never invent a contact address. Cite audit.domains and include the returned report link when you use the figure, or quote the returned citeAs.text.

budgetUsd.description: Optional: the most the user would pay, in US dollars.

consent.description: True only when the user asked you to file this request with this contact address. The call is refused without it.

contact.description: The user's own email address, given by the user for this request. The outcome is reported to it.

domain.description: The taken domain the user wants to buy.

timeline.description: Optional: how soon the user wants to buy.

name: request_domain_acquisition

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`. A stored interval also has no ODVS record: its artifact digest is provenance, not a standalone proof of these projected fields.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

inquiry.description: The paid next step, present when the filed request could be bound to a checkout.

title: Request to buy a taken domain, and optionally have it worked
